name: agentporter
description: Port libraries, CLI tools and binaries between programming languages with registry-checked dependency decisions, oracle fixtures, unit-by-unit implementation and a parity report.

interface.shortDescription: Port libraries and tools between languages, with proof.
interface.longDescription: AgentPorter moves a library, CLI tool or binary from one language to another. It surveys the source (or reverse engineers a binary with REA), recommends a target language, decides every dependency against live registries, records the original's behavior as fixtures, cuts the work into units, implements them one at a time and proves parity with a per-unit report.
defaultPrompt: Which language should I port this package to?
What is the status of this port?
